example.Arrays.comment: Create an int array, write an element, then read it. Array indices start at 0.
example.Branches.comment: Compare numbers and branch on the result. Try changing the first value.
example.Collections.comment: Add two strings to an ArrayList. Discard the unused return value of add with pop.

example.Methods.comment: Call another static method. Arguments go into slots #0 and #1 of calc.
example.Strings.comment: Append a string and a number to StringBuilder to form one string.
